descriptionChirho: A bright or white spot on the skin, a technical dermatological term in the Levitical purity laws (Leviticus 13-14) used to diagnose potential skin diseases including leprosy (tzaraat). All forms — singular, plural, with article, and with prepositional phrases — refer to the same diagnostic skin marking. Multilingual evidence is consistent: eng 'bright spot', spa 'mancha brillante', hin 'चमकीला दाग/सफेद', arb 'لُمْعَة/لُمَع', kor '밝은 반점', swa 'doa jeupe/madoa meupe'.
